unchanged_assertions: same white bath, glass screen, pedestal basin and WC in the same positions
same grey wall tiles, tile size, grout lines and tiled floor
same window, obscured glazing, chrome heated towel rail and grey towel
same toiletries on the windowsill and the same soap dispenser on the basin

no change to the room's shape or camera viewpoint
design_note: The bathroom arm of the probe. D2 targets the floor-junction sealant rather than the bath/wall junction because only the former is unambiguously inside the D-condition framing. Bathrooms are also where the T0 negative controls bite hardest — RP-002 asserts 'tile joints are not cracks' and 'no mould' — so a generator that sprays mould anywhere beyond the enumerated bead produces an unenumerated material change that the pair will catch.
